source.title: ICSE 2026 Examination: Biology (Science Paper 3)
source.subject: biology
source.authorityName: Council for the Indian School Certificate Examinations (CISCE)
source.extractionTool: pdftotext (poppler), -enc UTF-8, raw and -layout modes; pdfplumber for sub/superscripts and figure positions
source.notes: No official marking scheme is published with this paper; questions carry no official answer. Genuine ICSE 2026 board examination paper from the CISCE Archive Library bundle 'ICSE-2026-MAIN-1.zip' (folder 'ICSE 2026 MAIN'; the paper itself prints only the code 'T26 523'). Printed: Maximum Marks 80, Time allowed Two hours, 16 printed pages. Section A (40 marks) is compulsory: Question 1 has 15 one-mark MCQ/assertion-reason items; Question 2 has five 5-mark sub-questions (i)-(v); (i)-(iv) are split into their 1-mark parts (a)-(e) (marks from the [5] bracket, one per part), (v) is a single 5-mark matching item. Section B prints 'Attempt any four questions from this Section' over six 10-mark questions (3-8); all six are included, so the pack's marks total 100 against the printed maximum of 80 (pick 4 of 6, not an OR choice, so choiceGroup is not used). Section B sub-parts are kept at the printed (i)-(v) level with their printed marks; lettered parts (a)/(b)/(c) under them carry no separate marks and stay together.
source.usage: Official CISCE board examination paper from the CISCE Archive Library (cisce.org/archive-library); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to the original. Figures are not reproduced.

Four friends P, Q, R and S were discussing the examples of genetic disorders. The examples they quoted were as follows:
P. Colour blindness and Malaria
Q. Albinism and Cholera
R. Haemophilia and Colour blindness
S. Haemophilia and Albinism
Who gave the correct examples?
During the ventricular systole, the atrioventricular valves (P) ___________ and the semilunar valves (Q) __________.

Assertion (A): A thick cuticle reduces transpiration by acting as a barrier.
Reason (R): Desert plants have large, thin leaves for transpiration.
options: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A).
Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A).

Given below is the diagram of a human sperm. Read the information below the diagram and fill in the blanks:
Living organisms reproduce to form new individuals of their own kind. This is essential for the survival and continuation of species. Human sperms are microscopic structures that carry genetic material.
The head of the sperm has a cap like organelle called (a) ___________ (Lysosome / Acrosome) which produces an enzyme (b) __________ (Hyaluronidase / Amylase) that dissolves the outer layer of the ovum to facilitate fertilisation. The nucleus of the sperm has (c) __________ (23 / 46) chromosomes. The middle piece has (d) __________ (Chloroplast / Mitochondria) to provide energy for the motility of the sperm. (e) __________ (Semen / Hymen) is a mixture of sperms and the fluids produced by the male accessory glands.
extractionIssues: One continuous fill-in-the-blank passage with blanks (a)-(e); the full passage is repeated in each split entry and the target blank is identified by this entry's part label
Diagram of a human sperm on page 8 not reproduced; the blanks are answerable from the passage's own bracketed choices without it
